item.title: [IGNITE-5088] problems with trying OSGi
item.description:

I went through apache-ignite-2.0.0-src/modules/osgi/README.txt and stuck on this step

You may then run the OSGi test suite:

   mvn test -Dtest=IgniteOsgiTestSuite

mvn test -Dtest=IgniteOsgiTestSuite -DfailIfNoTests=false
